glosses: courtyard (an area, open to the sky, partially or wholly surrounded by walls or buildings)
yard (a small area adjoining the precincts of a house or other building)
vestibule (passage, hall or room between the outer door and the interior of a building)

examples.text: As crianças estavam brincando no pátio da escola.
examples.en: The kids were playing in the schoolyard.
